# Configuration reference

Every component reads its settings from `KNOWCEL_*` environment variables at startup and checks them: with an invalid value it exits with status 1 and one message that lists every problem (values that don't parse first, then the rules each component checks). The defaults suit local development; the compose files and the [Helm chart](operations/kubernetes.md) override what differs in a deployment. [`.env.example`](../.env.example) shows the ones you are most likely to change.

This page covers:

- every setting of the Go services (`Config` structs, with `config.Base`) and the Python components (`Settings` classes, with `PlatformSettings`), generated from their field comments and defaults;
- the variables the gateway and the web shell read when their containers start;
- the variables Docker Compose substitutes into the compose files, described from `.env.example`.

It does not cover the Helm chart's values ([deploy/helm/kb/values.yaml](../deploy/helm/kb/values.yaml)), the Dex configuration ([deploy/dex](../deploy/dex)) or the settings of third-party images (Postgres, NATS, SeaweedFS, Ollama).

Settings that must agree across modules: `KNOWCEL_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS` of the llm service is the length of the vectors in the document module's chunk index (`vector(768)` in `modules/document/migrations`); the document service compares the two once the llm service is reachable and logs an error if they differ. `KNOWCEL_CHUNK_TOKENIZER` and `KNOWCEL_EMBEDDING_MAX_TOKENS` of the ingestion worker belong to `KNOWCEL_EMBEDDING_MODEL` of the llm service.

## Every Go service

Read by every Go service, from `config.Base` in [platform/go/config](../platform/go/config/config.go). Each service's section gives its port defaults.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KNOWCEL_LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | The lowest level logged: debug, info, warn or error. |
| `KNOWCEL_LOG_FORMAT` | `json` | The log output: json (one object per line) or text. |
| `KNOWCEL_GRPC_PORT` | `per component` | Serves the gRPC API; each service defaults it to the port in its module.yaml. |
| `KNOWCEL_METRICS_PORT` | `per component` | Serves Prometheus metrics at /metrics (package metrics); like KNOWCEL_GRPC_PORT, each service defaults it to the port in its module.yaml. |
| `KNOWCEL_OTEL_ENDPOINT` | empty | The OTLP/gRPC endpoint spans go to, e.g. http://otel-collector:4317; tracing is off while it is empty. |

## Every Python component

Read by every Python component, from `PlatformSettings` in [knowcel_platform.config](../platform/python/src/knowcel_platform/config.py). Each component's section gives its port defaults.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KNOWCEL_LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` | Lowest level logged: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR. |
| `KNOWCEL_LOG_FORMAT` | `json` | Log output: json (one object per line) or text. |
| `KNOWCEL_GRPC_PORT` | `per component` | Serves the gRPC API; each component defaults it to the port in its module.yaml (0 for workers, which serve none). |
| `KNOWCEL_METRICS_PORT` | `per component` | Serves Prometheus metrics at /metrics (knowcel_platform.metrics); like KNOWCEL_GRPC_PORT, each component defaults it to the port in its module.yaml. |
| `KNOWCEL_NATS_URL` | `nats://localhost:4222` | NATS server with JetStream (comma-separated for a cluster); used by components that publish or consume events. |
| `KNOWCEL_OTEL_ENDPOINT` | empty | OTLP/gRPC endpoint spans go to, e.g. http://otel-collector:4317; tracing is off while it is empty (knowcel_platform.telemetry). |

## chat-service

From `Settings` in [modules/chat/service/src/knowcel_chat/config.py](../modules/chat/service/src/knowcel_chat/config.py), in addition to the settings every Python component reads.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KNOWCEL_GRPC_PORT` | `9003` | Serves the gRPC API; each component defaults it to the port in its module.yaml (0 for workers, which serve none). |
| `KNOWCEL_METRICS_PORT` | `9103` | Serves Prometheus metrics at /metrics (knowcel_platform.metrics); like KNOWCEL_GRPC_PORT, each component defaults it to the port in its module.yaml. |
| `KNOWCEL_DATABASE_URL` | `postgresql+asyncpg://kb:kb@localhost:5432/kb` | The Postgres database holding the chat schema, as an SQLAlchemy URL. |
| `KNOWCEL_DOCUMENT_ADDR` | `localhost:9001` | The document module (host:port), which retrieves the passages. |
| `KNOWCEL_LLM_ADDR` | `localhost:9004` | The llm module (host:port), which embeds questions and generates answers. |
| `KNOWCEL_RAG_TOP_K` | `5` | Number of chunks retrieved for grounding an answer. |
| `KNOWCEL_RAG_MIN_SCORE` | `0.5` | Cosine similarity (-1 to 1) a chunk needs to count as related to the question. Measured with nomic-embed-text: the passage answering a question scores about 0.67-0.84, the best chunk for an unrelated question at most 0.44. Tune it together with the embedding model. |
| `KNOWCEL_HISTORY_LIMIT` | `20` | Previous messages loaded as context; the token budget below may drop the oldest. |
| `KNOWCEL_CONTEXT_TOKENS` | `4096` | Context window of the chat model in tokens. 4096 is Ollama's default window; raise it together with the model's num_ctx. |
| `KNOWCEL_ANSWER_RESERVE_TOKENS` | `1024` | Tokens of the context window kept free for the answer. The prompt (instructions, sources, history, question) gets the rest. |
| `KNOWCEL_MANUAL_DIR` | `docs/user-manual` | Directory of the user manual chat answers how-to questions from. |
| `KNOWCEL_MANUAL_TOP_K` | `2` | Manual sections an answer may cite on top of the document passages. |
| `KNOWCEL_MANUAL_MIN_SCORE` | `0.65` | Cosine similarity a manual section needs to be cited: with nomic-embed-text, how-to questions score about 0.7-0.8 and unrelated ones below 0.56. |

## document-service

From `Config` in [modules/document/service/cmd/document-service](../modules/document/service/cmd/document-service/main.go), in addition to the settings every Go service reads.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KNOWCEL_GRPC_PORT` | `9001` | Serves the gRPC API; each service defaults it to the port in its module.yaml. |
| `KNOWCEL_METRICS_PORT` | `9101` | Serves Prometheus metrics at /metrics (package metrics); like KNOWCEL_GRPC_PORT, each service defaults it to the port in its module.yaml. |
| `KNOWCEL_DATABASE_URL` | `postgres://kb:kb@localhost:5432/kb?sslmode=disable` | The Postgres database holding the document schema. |
| `KNOWCEL_NATS_URL` | `nats://localhost:4222` | The NATS server with JetStream the reindex events are published to (comma-separated for several). |
| `KNOWCEL_S3_ENDPOINT` | `localhost:8333` | The S3 server the service reads and writes, host:port without a scheme. |
| `KNOWCEL_S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT` | `localhost:8333` | The S3 address browsers use, host:port without a scheme; upload and download URLs are signed for it. |
| `KNOWCEL_S3_ACCESS_KEY` | `kb` | The S3 access key id. |
| `KNOWCEL_S3_SECRET_KEY` | `kb-secret-key` | The S3 secret access key. |
| `KNOWCEL_S3_BUCKET` | `documents` | Holds the document files; the service creates it if missing. |
| `KNOWCEL_S3_USE_SSL` | `false` | Talks HTTPS to both endpoints. |
| `KNOWCEL_S3_REGION` | `us-east-1` | The S3 region URLs are signed for. |
| `KNOWCEL_LLM_ADDR` | `localhost:9004` | The llm module (host:port), needed by SearchDocuments and the startup check of the embedding dimension. |
| `KNOWCEL_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` | `52428800` | The largest file accepted. 50 MiB fits long PDFs while bounding the ingestion worker, which holds a whole file and its extracted text in memory. |
| `KNOWCEL_ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES` | `application/pdf,text/*,application/json,application/yaml,application/x-yaml` | Media types ("application/pdf") or wildcards of a top-level type ("text/*"). The default is what the ingestion worker extracts text from (extract_pages in knowcel_ingestion_worker/extract.py). |
| `KNOWCEL_CLEANUP_INTERVAL` | `1h` | The time between sweeps; 0 turns the sweeper off. |
| `KNOWCEL_UPLOAD_TTL` | `24h` | How long a document may wait for its upload before it is removed. It must be longer than upload URLs stay valid (15 minutes). |
| `KNOWCEL_ORPHAN_GRACE` | `1h` | How old an object without a document must be before it is removed, so that an upload racing a delete is not judged too early. |

## ingestion-worker

From `Settings` in [modules/ingestion/worker/src/knowcel_ingestion_worker/config.py](../modules/ingestion/worker/src/knowcel_ingestion_worker/config.py), in addition to the settings every Python component reads.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KNOWCEL_METRICS_PORT` | `9105` | Serves Prometheus metrics at /metrics (knowcel_platform.metrics); like KNOWCEL_GRPC_PORT, each component defaults it to the port in its module.yaml. |
| `KNOWCEL_DOCUMENT_ADDR` | `localhost:9001` | The document module (host:port), whose documents the worker reads and fills. |
| `KNOWCEL_LLM_ADDR` | `localhost:9004` | The llm module (host:port), which embeds the chunks. |
| `KNOWCEL_CHUNK_TOKENIZER` | `nomic-embed-text` | Chunks are measured in tokens of the embedding model's tokenizer: a name bundled in knowcel_ingestion_worker/vocab (nomic-embed-text) or a path to a Hugging Face tokenizer.json. Change it together with KNOWCEL_EMBEDDING_MODEL on the llm service. |
| `KNOWCEL_CHUNK_TOKENS` | `256` | Size of a chunk in tokens; it must fit KNOWCEL_EMBEDDING_MAX_TOKENS. |
| `KNOWCEL_CHUNK_OVERLAP_TOKENS` | `32` | Tokens a chunk repeats from the end of the previous one, below KNOWCEL_CHUNK_TOKENS. |
| `KNOWCEL_CHUNK_MIN_SECTION_TOKENS` | `50` | Markdown sections shorter than this (tokens) merge with the next section at the same level, so that a heading with a line of text isn't a chunk of its own. |
| `KNOWCEL_EMBEDDING_MAX_TOKENS` | `2048` | Input limit of the embedding model in tokens, special tokens included. Ollama runs nomic-embed-text with a 2048-token context. |
| `KNOWCEL_EMBED_BATCH_SIZE` | `32` | Chunks sent to the llm module per Embed call. |
| `KNOWCEL_MAX_DELIVER` | `5` | Deliveries of one upload before it fails for good. Transient errors (a peer unavailable or overloaded) are retried, other errors fail the document at once. |
| `KNOWCEL_RETRY_DELAY` | `5` | Seconds before the first retry of a transient error; doubles with each retry. |
| `KNOWCEL_RETRY_MAX_DELAY` | `300` | Seconds the delay between retries grows to at most. |
| `KNOWCEL_WORKER_CONCURRENCY` | `2` | Uploads processed at the same time. 2 overlaps one document's download, extraction and storing with another's embedding without piling requests on a single local embedding model, which works through them one by one anyway on CPU. Raise it when the embedding backend runs requests in parallel (a GPU, a hosted provider, Ollama with OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL). |

## llm-service

From `Settings` in [modules/llm/service/src/knowcel_llm/config.py](../modules/llm/service/src/knowcel_llm/config.py), in addition to the settings every Python component reads.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KNOWCEL_GRPC_PORT` | `9004` | Serves the gRPC API; each component defaults it to the port in its module.yaml (0 for workers, which serve none). |
| `KNOWCEL_METRICS_PORT` | `9104` | Serves Prometheus metrics at /metrics (knowcel_platform.metrics); like KNOWCEL_GRPC_PORT, each component defaults it to the port in its module.yaml. |
| `KNOWCEL_LLM_PROVIDER` | `ollama` | Provider for chat and embeddings, a name in knowcel_llm.providers.REGISTRY: ollama, anthropic or fake. |
| `KNOWCEL_CHAT_PROVIDER` | empty | Provider for Generate (chat) only, e.g. anthropic with Ollama embeddings; empty falls back to KNOWCEL_LLM_PROVIDER. |
| `KNOWCEL_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER` | empty | Provider for Embed only; empty falls back to KNOWCEL_LLM_PROVIDER. |
| `KNOWCEL_OLLAMA_URL` | `http://localhost:11434` | Ollama server (provider ollama). |
| `KNOWCEL_CHAT_MODEL` | `llama3.2` | Default chat model of the ollama provider. |
| `KNOWCEL_EMBEDDING_MODEL` | `nomic-embed-text` | Default embedding model of the ollama provider; change the ingestion worker's KNOWCEL_CHUNK_TOKENIZER with it. |
| `KNOWCEL_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | empty | Anthropic API key, required by provider anthropic (chat only: Anthropic has no embeddings). |
| `KNOWCEL_ANTHROPIC_CHAT_MODEL` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` | Default chat model of the anthropic provider. |
| `KNOWCEL_ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS` | `16000` | Upper bound for one answer when the caller sets none (the API requires one). |
| `KNOWCEL_PROVIDER_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` | `5` | Seconds to connect to a provider. |
| `KNOWCEL_PROVIDER_FIRST_TOKEN_TIMEOUT` | `120` | Seconds until the first token of an answer. Generous on purpose: a CPU-only Ollama can take minutes to load a model. |
| `KNOWCEL_PROVIDER_GENERATE_TIMEOUT` | `600` | Seconds one whole answer may take. |
| `KNOWCEL_PROVIDER_EMBED_TIMEOUT` | `120` | Seconds one Embed call may take. |
| `KNOWCEL_PROVIDER_LIST_TIMEOUT` | `10` | Seconds to list a provider's models or check its health. |
| `KNOWCEL_PROVIDER_ATTEMPTS` | `3` | Attempts for idempotent calls (embed, list), doubling the delay after each. |
| `KNOWCEL_PROVIDER_RETRY_DELAY` | `0.5` | Seconds before the second attempt. |
| `KNOWCEL_PROVIDER_MAX_CONCURRENCY` | `8` | Generate and Embed calls in flight per provider, above which calls are rejected. |
| `KNOWCEL_FAKE_TOKEN_DELAY` | `0` | Seconds the fake provider waits before each word; 0 streams at once. |
| `KNOWCEL_FAKE_EMBEDDING_MODEL` | `fake-embed` | The embedding model the fake provider reports (and hashes into its vectors). |
| `KNOWCEL_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS` | `768` | Length of the embedding vectors. Must match the vector column of the document module's chunk index, which checks it at startup. |

## Gateway (Envoy)

Read when the container starts, by [deploy/envoy/entrypoint.sh](../deploy/envoy/entrypoint.sh).

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KNOWCEL_OIDC_ISSUER` | `http://localhost:5556/dex` | OIDC issuer whose tokens the gateway accepts (the `iss` claim; browsers and tests fetch tokens there). Defaults to the dev Dex; with another KNOWCEL_DEX_PORT change the issuer's port too. |
| `KNOWCEL_OIDC_JWKS_URL` | `http://dex:5556/dex/keys` | Where Envoy fetches the issuer's signing keys (http or https). |
| `KNOWCEL_OIDC_AUDIENCES` | `kb-web,kb-cli` | Client ids (token audiences) the gateway accepts, comma-separated. |

## Web shell

Read when the container starts, by [deploy/docker/web/40-runtime-config.sh](../deploy/docker/web/40-runtime-config.sh).

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KNOWCEL_VERSION` | `dev` | Version the images are built as and report (the web shell logs it at start); deploy/release.compose.yaml requires a released one, e.g. 0.3.1. |
| `KNOWCEL_ENABLED_MODULES` | empty | Comma-separated module ids to show in the UI (empty = all). |
| `KNOWCEL_OIDC_ISSUER` | `http://localhost:5556/dex` | OIDC issuer whose tokens the gateway accepts (the `iss` claim; browsers and tests fetch tokens there). Defaults to the dev Dex; with another KNOWCEL_DEX_PORT change the issuer's port too. |
| `KNOWCEL_OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | `kb-web` | The web shell's client id at the issuer (authorization code with PKCE). |
| `KNOWCEL_API_BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:8080` | Addresses the browser uses (keep in sync with the ports above): the gateway the web shell calls, and the object store upload and download URLs point at. |

| Variable | Default | Description | Used in |
|---|---|---|---|

| `KNOWCEL_WEB_DEV_PORT` | `5173` | Port of the Vite dev server (task web); Dex allows it as a redirect URI. | `deploy/infra.compose.yaml` |
| `KNOWCEL_DEX_PORT` | `5556` | Host port of the dev Dex identity provider. | `deploy/infra.compose.yaml` |

| `KNOWCEL_JAEGER_PORT` | `16686` | Host port of the Jaeger UI (observability profile). | `deploy/infra.compose.yaml` |
| `KNOWCEL_PROMETHEUS_PORT` | `9090` | Host port of the Prometheus UI (observability profile). | `deploy/infra.compose.yaml` |
